+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,20 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```bash
+python -m pytest
+```
+
+To run a single file or a single test:
+
+```bash
+python -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py
+python -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py::test_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
+
+Note: the repo does not contain any test files yet, so the command above
+currently collects zero tests. Add `test_*.py` files next to the modules they
+cover and they will be picked up automatically.
